next_step: Finish POC perf report, pricing review with CFO week of 2026-03-15
notes:
Topline: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood for embeddings + semantic search. Currently prototyping hosted API, plan to move to Dedicated if throughput/cost align.

Context: Elmshore runs in-app "Insight Search" used by product teams at ~250 customers. Index size ~50M short documents (metadata + small text blobs). Nightly batch ingest of ~200k new/updated docs; incremental streaming for real-time updates (~5k/day). They use Pinecone today for vector store, but are open to tighter integration or moving vector storage to Redwood-managed or self-hosted as part of Dedicated.

POC goals & success criteria:
- Embedding throughput: be able to embed 200k docs in nightly window (8-12 hours) 
- Query latency: 95th percentile for semantic queries < 150ms (goal), acceptable < 250ms
- Cost target: total monthly per-customer embedding + query unit cost to be <= $0.03 per active MAU (rough internal target)
- Bulk ingest/connector: want native S3 -> bulk embed and delta ingest support or clear best-practice using Redwood batching
- Vector compatibility: need compatibility with Pinecone schema and ability to export/import vectors without re-embedding

Technical notes from the POC:
- Ran Hosted API POC (2/18 demo): 10k concurrent lookups simulated, 95th latency ~180ms when routed to us-east hosted model. Observed tail latency spikes during burst windows.
- Batch embedding test: 50k docs/hour sustained on hosted API with automated batching enabled; extrapolated full-night run ~8-12 hours depending on instance throttling.
- Concern: hosted burst pricing for large nightly jobs may exceed Dedicated reserved capacity economics.
- Model preference: leaning open LLM embeddings (Redwood-verified embedding models); want ability to pin model version for consistency.
- Ops: need per-token / per-route cost breakdown, and token retention/audit logs for compliance.

Security & compliance:
- Must support SSO (SAML), SOC2, audit logging, and option for EU data residency for a subset of customers.
- Legal flagged data residency and contract-level SLAs as blockers for Dedicated purchase.

Customer quotes / call snippets:
- CTO: "95th <150ms is non-negotiable for product adoption among our enterprise accounts."
- Head of Data: "If we can get predictable batch throughput and a clear path to lower unit cost for embeddings, Dedicated makes financial sense."

Commercial / procurement:
- Interested in a 12-month reserved Dedicated proposal with burst credits. CFO wants a modeled TCO comparing hosted vs dedicated including expected growth (x3 index size in 12 months).

Next steps (sales playbook):
- Deliver POC perf report with measured throughput/latency and recommended Dedicated sizing (Maya).
- Provide a dedicated pricing worksheet (engineers + pricing) and sample SLA addendum for EU residency (Jordan + Pricing).
- Setup technical deep-dive with infra team re: bulk ingest S3 connector and vector export/import workflows (Maya + infra eng).
- Legal to get Redwood's security pack + SOC2 artifacts (Liam to coordinate).

Staging notes: feeler for Redwood Optimize — they liked batching/caching recommendations in demo. Interested in automated reranking pipelines + evals tied to prompt set.
